Fed's Dec. Meeting May Mark Turning Point for Markets: Economist
general.summary: Mohit Kumar, chief European economist and strategist at Jefferies, discusses the outlook for the Federal Reserve's December policy meeting and its potential impact on markets. "My base case is that is the peak in hawkishness," Kumar tells Bloomberg Television. "That is, in my mind, the turning point for markets." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Chinese chip stocks notch biggest ever one-day gains as Beijing signals broader market support
general.summary: Chinese stocks rebounded sharply after a rare intraday state media readout cheered investors as top policymakers pledged market liquidity support.

general.title: European Workers’ AI Use on Par With That of US Peers, ECB Says
general.summary: Euro-area workers are turning to artificial intelligence at a similar rate as their peers in the US, though obstacles remain to reaping more of the technology’s benefits, according to European Central Bank research.

general.title: India’s RBI to Help Small Firms Grow Globally, Malhotra Says
general.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will strengthen its credit infrastructure to help the country’s small businesses scale up and compete globally, Governor Sanjay Malhotra said.

general.title: Zambia Pauses Rate Cuts as Kwacha Slide Threatens Inflation
general.summary: Zambia’s central bank kept interest rates unchanged as new inflation pressures emerge from a slump in the currency and a super El Niño.
